payout_quote: Volunteers are paid for their time. Compensation varies, but rates average about $10 per hour.
steps: Open the Beckman Institute I-HELP page
Complete the I-HELP volunteer signup form (redcap link on the page) or subscribe to the newsletter
Receive invitations to Beckman/UIUC lab studies on aging, cognition, health, and technology
Choose which project(s) to participate in — you may decline any invitation and keep your volunteer position
Complete the study visit(s) (often one visit, 1-3 hours) and get paid, averaging about $10/hour
catches: Pay is an average ('about $10 per hour'), not a guaranteed rate — actual compensation varies by project
Study invitations are periodic; no guaranteed schedule or income level
Many projects require one in-person visit in Urbana, IL (1-3 hours); some activities can be done at home
Research focuses on adult development and aging topics
biggest_catch: Pay is stated as an average ('about $10/hour') that varies by project — not a guaranteed hourly rate — and study invitations are periodic.
eligibility: Adults ages 18 and older; project-specific requirements vary and are stated per invitation.
timing: Many projects require only one visit, usually 1-3 hours; some activities at home. Payment timing per project not stated on the page.
